presets.description: Fixed Panda parallel gripper on LIBERO; validated legacy atomic tools and Mink execution.
Dual X5 on RoboDojo; registered adaptation target, execution pending capability validation.
Fixed left-mounted X5, calibrated RGB-D/TCP, checked joint IK and official RoboDojo pickup outcome. Single-arm acceptance profile.
Native fixed dual X5 with calibrated RGB-D/TCP, independent arm holds, synchronized checked Cartesian actions and inter-arm collision detection.
Development acceptance profile for native sweep_blocks and pour_balls_into_vase; same calibrated fixed dual X5 and checked execution as pickup, task success unverified.
Development admission canary for 32 static/rigid base task candidates. Candidate registration does not establish geometry coverage or task success.
Development cloth profile: short TCP segments, per-physics-step measured cloth checks, local finger contact, synchronized shared cloth. No future deformation guarantee. Task success unverified.
Extended-budget experiment: align_blocks native action quota 200 -> 400; unchanged native success predicates. Not comparable to the original 200-action baseline.

Experimental rigid contact profile: generic motion/gripper, no intent authorization or automatic spatial detours; measured bounded finger contact, no force control or held-object trajectory prediction.

Experimental rigid contact profile: generic motion/gripper, no intent authorization or automatic spatial detours; measured bounded finger contact, no force control or held-object trajectory prediction.

Experimental v71: billed bounded wait, public-frame relative translation, verified live world-articulation links. Admission/diagnostic coverage only, not task success or force control. Native budgets unchanged.

Experimental v72: explicit 0.5–3 mm final-position criteria, bounded native tracking and truthful failure feedback. No change to native drives, assets or scoring. SDF/GPU and force control are not enabled.

Isolated GPU tensor pipeline and Fabric experiment; unchanged native assets/reward/budget. Native SDF reads under diagnosis, SDF collision admission remains disabled; not comparable to CPU baseline without regression.
Visual short-horizon cloth; generic finger contact, synchronized dual-arm requests, private geometry for safety only. Native material friction unchanged.

Visual short-horizon cloth; generic finger contact, synchronized dual-arm requests, private geometry for safety only. Garment material friction doubled in an isolated service; separate modified-physics condition, not native baseline.

Visual short-horizon cloth; generic finger contact, synchronized dual-arm requests, private geometry for safety only. Native material friction unchanged. Public calibrated TCP overlays alongside original images; no demonstration loaded by default.

Garment material friction doubled in an isolated service; separate modified-physics condition, not native baseline. Public calibrated TCP overlays alongside original images; no demonstration loaded by default.
Build-tower ablation: native rigid dual X5 physical contact, public TCP overlays, unchanged native/adapter quotas.
Build-tower paired ablation; explicit 2000 native and adapter actions, unchanged controller, RGB/TCP aids, physics and rewards. Separate modified-budget condition.
Build-tower feasibility run: explicit 4000 native and adapter actions; unchanged controller, RGB/TCP aids, physics and rewards. Separate modified-budget condition.
Opt-in build-tower semantic completion oracle; 4000 actions, same physical control and public TCP overlays. Privileged-derived feedback must be reported separately.
Same semantic completion oracle and robot control as v78; records same-frame public TCP/calibration for annotated and raw review videos.

Opt-in native coarse completion feedback; observes existing evaluator calls and historical state, without extra predicate evaluation. General checker supports 42 pinned base task sources; this preset is the build-tower live canary, not 42-task execution certification.

Native query surface voxel covers at 0.5 mm, with conservative union contact bounds and unchanged physical-contact execution. Catalog registration covers 42 native tasks; registration is not execution or task success certification.
Conveyor image task diagnostic: native physics and action budget, visual TCP, coarse completion feedback; bounded motion available.
Conveyor diagnostic with unchanged six public original/TCP views, opt-in verified lossless WebP when smaller, native physics/reward/budgets.
Conveyor diagnostic with public-visual held-object traffic-clearance skill revision; same lossless six views and native physics/reward/budgets as v86.
Conveyor host with optional hash-pinned historical visual/action experience reader; native physics/reward/budgets. Experience selection and conditioning are separately recorded.
Conveyor visual/action experience condition with robot-only measured TCP-plane jaw aperture feedback and grasp-region skill advice; unchanged actions, physics, reward and native budgets.
Conveyor with four-second per-edge Cartesian certification inside the existing total planning deadline, unchanged collision criteria and native controller; optional fixed visual/action history.

Conveyor with checked partial dual schedules under explicit observation ceilings, prominent public collision evidence summaries, unchanged native physics/reward/budgets. Conditioning is separately recorded.

Conveyor retaining issued finger drive targets at ordinary requested observation-horizon stops, with explicit robot-only hold readback and unchanged collision stops, native drives, physics/reward/budgets. Conditioning is separately recorded.

Conveyor with explicit closest-tested IK collision evidence, actual finger-role contact-bound attribution and positive-gap feedback; unchanged admission, native drives, physics/reward/budgets. Conditioning is separately recorded.
Compose existing-overlap retreat and positive-submargin recovery without changing either guarantee; same native physics/reward/budgets and separately recorded conditioning.
Same v94 runtime with optional pick-place advice for public visual point offsets and supported receiving containers; unchanged tools, controller, physics/reward/budgets.
